replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map looks really nice. The terraforming you have done is really nice and that being followed with a nice looking palette really makes the maps aesthetics stand out.

I'll start with the walls. I really like the look of the walls but one thing that I would change is fences. Due to some players complaining about performance I would not use so many fences. Instead I think you could just use stairs so you still have a 3D-ish feel but better performance on lower end PCs

I like the river and the paths. I've always been a fan of paths like that but the river with the lilypads is really nice. The bridge also looks really nice.

The trees look decent. They are not amazing but they still look nice and I like the implementation of cobwebs. I also really like the wheat field.

As for buildings, the houses look like they could use some work. The one with the flat roof needs quite a lot of improvements. While the other one doesnt need as many, it still needs some minor changes.

The windmill could use a lot of work. The base of it is mostly wood. Its plain and needs some nicer decoration added as well as some changes with blocks that you used. For the "blades" they look too diagonal. Making some curvingness with them and implementing fences would IMO solve that issue.

Now that I am done with aesthetics I will go a bit more into gameplay.

With the way you terraformed the map and layed out the paths the map looks like it will play decently. The only concern I have is the diamonds you put on the map. I would rather have it so you only get iron gear from the four areas and have diamonds in the middle but not in the caves. That can lead to very unbalanced gameplay.

Everything else looks really nice and gameplay shouldn't be that bad. Good job!

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
One person can get full diamond. They won't share it. Compare that to a team that will and the team with the full diamond guy might take the other team out completely with a single player which hurts gameplay a bit.

I'd still remove them and have them in the middle but if you want to keep them, at least split the number in half or have it 2 per player on the team for a diamond sword and don't have them close to each other

replies.author: potatoarmor
replies.body:
If you took away all diamonds except for the middle, I would say it was a good map.  If you leave the diamonds, it is just like one of a dozen other maps. 

And get rid of the potions.  What you have is a good layout with bad gameplay since people will *sigh* rush for the diamonds instead of looking for iron or building things.
